messages:
Maya: Heads-up — p99 for the canary route spiked after the v3.2.7 rollout around 03:02 UTC. p95 went from ~420ms to ~1.1s and p99 climbed from ~2.3s to ~6.8s. Seeing streaming stalls and some requests stuck in read loops. Canary ramped to 20% at ~03:02.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO breach detected — p99 > 5s on route com.redwood.inference.gen (canary/model=v3.2.7). Paging @Sam (oncall). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/canary-latency

Sam: on it, grabbing logs and will pause traffic if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated by maya at 03:00 UTC — model v3.2.6 -> v3.2.7, target traffic 20%. rollout_id=rl_5590

Maya: Confirming stalls mostly happen for long-context streaming + tool-calls. A few clients see repeated reconnects.

Linh: Observing KV cache eviction thrashing on nodes serving v3.2.7, plus memcpy spikes. Logs excerpt:
```
[03:02:45] kv-cache: eviction_loop took 180ms (threshold 10ms)
[03:02:46] runtime: memcpy 25ms (expected <1ms)
[03:02:47] stream: stall detected, client=app-prod-3, req=abc123
```

Sam: Can we reweight traffic back to v3.2.6 (20% -> 0%) immediately? I'll run the traffic API now.

Sam: running rollback command — executing traffic reweight to 100% v3.2.6
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/rollouts/traffic" \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"route":"com.redwood.inference.gen","model":"v3.2.6","weights":{"v3.2.6":100,"v3.2.7":0}}'
```

deploy-bot: Traffic update accepted (job_id=jb_9832). Applying config to all load-balancer groups.

Sam: Verified — canary weight now 0% across clusters. Early signal: p99 dropping to ~700ms and streaming stalls count decreasing.

Oliver: CS flagged two paying customers (cust-987, cust-102) experiencing high latency; I've pinged CS and will prepare a status blurb for them.

Maya: Good. Hold all model rollouts until we triage root cause. Action items: repro in staging, memcpy profiling, and check quantization differences between v3.2.6 & v3.2.7.

Linh: Repro steps I will run: load test with seq_len=2048 + tool-call streaming payload to exercise KV eviction. Trying a dev build that increases KV sizing.

Sam: Temporary mitigation: added circuit breaker for route to abort requests >8s and return 503 to callers while we investigate. Command used: `redwoodctl set-policy --route com.redwood.inference.gen --circuit 8s`

incident-bot: Paging escalations paused — oncall acknowledged. Incident severity set to Sev2.

Oliver: I'll post to the status page with ETA ~30m for mitigation. @cs-team please coordinate direct outreach to cust-987 & cust-102.

Maya: Once we can reproduce, we'll decide whether to re-release v3.2.7 with KV sizing fix or hold and iterate.

deploy-bot: Rollback job jb_9832 completed on all clusters at 03:13 UTC — rollout reverted to v3.2.6.

Sam: Final verification: p99 ~630ms, streaming stall traces cleared on the nodes we saw earlier. Leaving monitoring pinned for the next hour.

Oliver: Status update posted: "Mitigation in place — traffic rolled back to v3.2.6. Investigating root cause (KV cache thrashing)." Will follow up with impacted customers.

Maya: Thanks. Postmortem owners: Sam (ops) & Linh (runtime). We'll schedule a 90-minute postmortem to capture timeline, repro, and longer-term fixes.

Sam: ack, adding notes to incident board and creating initial postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
